colony.name: Colony
colony.description: Settle a habitable world. Colonies grow in population, pay taxes, do some research and can host colony buildings (shipyard, trade hub, defenses). Founded by a Colony Ship, never built.

outpost.name: Outpost
outpost.description: A bare claim: a beacon, a depot and a few automated guns on a rock, belt, ice moon or gas giant. Claims an unclaimed system for you; a real development (mining base, research station) can be built over it later. Built by a Constructor.

mining_base.name: Mining Base
mining_base.description: Automated mines on a rocky world or asteroid belt. Built by a Constructor.

research_station.name: Research Station
research_station.description: A sealed science base on an ice moon, gas giant or barren rock. Built by a Constructor.

gas_refinery.name: Gas Refinery
gas_refinery.description: Skims fuel from a gas giant's upper atmosphere and sells it. Built by a Constructor.

ice_mine.name: Ice Mine
ice_mine.description: Cracks water ice and helium-3 out of a frozen moon or an icy rock and ships it home. Needs a volatiles deposit and extracts it. Built by a Constructor.

exotic_containment.name: Exotic Containment
exotic_containment.description: Magnetic bottles and a skeleton crew of physicists harvest exotic matter, and study it. Needs an exotic matter deposit and extracts it; can be built over another development. Built by a Constructor.

trade_hub.name: Trade Hub
trade_hub.description: Markets and docks. Needs a colony.

defense_platform.name: Defense Platform
defense_platform.description: Orbital gun platform. Fights any enemy that attacks the system. Needs a colony.

hydroponic_farm.name: Hydroponic Farms
hydroponic_farm.description: Vertical farms feed a growing population: faster growth on this colony. Needs a colony.

academy.name: Research Academy
academy.description: Universities and labs: research that grows with the colony's population. Needs a colony.

commerce_exchange.name: Commerce Exchange
commerce_exchange.description: A trading floor: credits that grow with the colony's population. Needs a colony.

orbital_habitat.name: Orbital Habitat
orbital_habitat.description: Ring habitats raise this world's population cap by 4. Needs a colony.

sensor_array.name: Sensor Array
sensor_array.description: Long-range sensors: +2 sensor range for the system. Needs a colony.

planetary_shield.name: Planetary Shield
planetary_shield.description: A shield bastion that fights any enemy attacking the system (tougher than a platform). Needs a colony.

fleet_academy.name: Fleet Academy
fleet_academy.description: Trains commanders: every fleet commander earns 12 XP per turn. Needs a colony.

jump_gate.name: Jump Gate
jump_gate.description: A ring of exotic-matter conduits: your fleets here jump to any of your other Jump Gates in one move. Needs a colony.
